name: founder_casual
description: A warmer founder-to-founder style that still stays evidence-led and avoids fake praise.
opening_style: Open conversationally and directly, as if a founder quickly checked the app, landing page, or signup flow.
angle_priorities: Specific friction in the first user action.
Unclear signup, booking, checkout, or activation flow.
Weak proof or unclear value proposition.
qc_focus: Avoid sounding like a formal audit.
Still include a concrete outcome like conversion, activation, bookings, or drop-off.
example_good_lines: I had a look at the MindTrack app and the first screen asks users to pick between several paths before showing value, I'd guess some people bounce because the next step is not obvious.
I was just checking out the CareLoop website and the demo CTA gets buried under three different audience messages, that probably makes the page harder to act on.
example_bad_lines: Your app seems really innovative and helpful.
I was impressed by your mission.
